changes.title: Per-tool enhancement card prerender mein upar aa gaya (AEO block ke baad)
changes.why: Runtime injector (js/tool-enhance.js) pehle se hi card ko pehle explain-card ke andar append karta tha, magar SSG usay FAQ se just pehle rakhta tha — yani prerender (jo crawler padhta hai) aur hydrated DOM ka order alag tha. Naapne par pata chala ke page ka unique data-table 35-37% depth par chala jata tha.
changes.tradeoff: Worked example lafz card ke andar nahi hai, is liye guide ka text ~130-200 words neeche khisak gaya (22% → 27-30%), magar pehle teesre hisse mein hi raha. Yani table bohot upar aaya, example thoda neeche — dono exposed.

changes.title: guides/business-days: '3 to 5 business days' ka start-weekday table + weekday formula + month/year answers
changes.why: GSC join mein 165 distinct queries hain, sab position 58-81 par. Sab se zyada poochhi gayi shakal dates ki hai ('3 business days from today', 'how long is 2 to 7 business days', 'how long is 3-5 business days', 'work days in may', '365 minus weekends'), jab ke page par sirf ek generic '10 business days ≈ 2 weeks' line thi. Table start-weekday par keyed hai (dates par nahi) is liye ye evergreen hai.
changes.measured: table 195→140 words (45.3% → 18.6%) · question 186→73 (43.3% → 9.7%) · formula bucket missing se present · page 430→752 words
changes.tradeoff: Naya table FAQ ko neeche dhakelta hai, is liye comparison/modifier bucket ke offsets +194/+207 words barhe (dono pehle se hi threshold se bahar the). Title ki truncated shakal '...Deadlines & the' bhi theek hui — ab 'Business Days Calculator — Workday Math & Deadlines'.

changes.title: Region/year bucket bhara: #1 page (home-insurance) + expose tier ke mortgage pages
changes.why: Exposure report ka action='expose' tier aur content coverage mila kar ek hi baqi gap nikla: `region` bucket. /lifestyle/home-insurance (#1 page, 75 queries, 1003 impressions) par ye missing bhi tha aur 54.8% depth par bhi (wahan sirf footer ka saal match ho raha tha). Wahi gap /finance/fha-loan aur /finance/pmi-calculator par bhi tha. Section ka kaam slider nahi, intepretation hai: rate per $1,000 hi wo input hai jo location badalti hai, is liye user ko batana zaroori hai ke US/Canada rate-per-$1,000 convention hai aur UK/Australia sum-insured convention — warna wo ghalat number type karta hai.
changes.measured: Neeche §4 dekho (baseline: data/page-exposure-baseline-v2.json). Expected: teeno pages par region bucket missing→present, coverage 87.5%→100%, depth threshold ke andar.
changes.tradeoff: Card ke andar ~160 words add hue, is liye card ke baad wala 'worked example' thoda neeche khisakta hai (home-insurance par usay card ke andar hi label kar diya gaya, is liye wahan exposure bigi nahi). 35% threshold ka khayal rakha gaya. Query side par region abhi kisi query mein nahi maanga ja raha (GSC join), to ye 'keyword checklist' nahi — page ka interpretation gap hai; impressions ka koi dawa nahi.

changes.title: Runtime injector ka order prerender se match kar diya (appendChild → prepend)
changes.why: SSG card ko aeo block ke baad rakhta hai, magar hydration par renderTool()/renderExplain() #mainContent dobara banate hain aur injector card ko himayat wale explain-card ke *aakhir* mein jodta tha — us block mein aakhir mein FAQ hota hai. Yani crawler card ko page ke shuru mein padhta tha aur user usay FAQ ke baad dekhta tha. Prerender ka faida user ko nahi mil raha tha.
changes.measured: Hydrated DOM ka h2 order (home-insurance): pehle 'How it works' → … → 'Frequently Asked Questions' → card; ab 'How does it work?' → card → 'How it works' → … → FAQ — yani prerender order se bilkul match. Measurement (deploy/ HTML) is tabdeeli se mutate nahi hoti kyunki wo prerender padhta hai; ye proof browser DOM ka hai.
changes.tradeoff: Card ab seo-guide explain-block ke shuru mein nest hota hai (pehle aakhir mein tha). CSS par koi asar nahi dikha — screenshot se verify kiya gaya.

changes.title: Write tier batch 1: apy-calculator ka value table + AER/APR naming, aur business-days ke table mein +10 column
changes.why: Write tier ka #1 page /finance/apy-calculator hai (63 queries, 263 impressions, queryCoverage 62.5%). Uski queries do cheezein maangti hain jo page par nahi thin: (a) seedha value lookup — 'what is 3.50 apy on 10000', '4.25 apy on $10000', '4.10 apy on 10000' — aur (b) region/year label — koi bhi query country ka naam nahi leti, magar tool ka naam US-specific hai aur international users ke liye 'AER' wahi number hai.Observed SERP (12 Oct) ne bhi yahi dikhaya: PAA mein 'How much money will I earn on $10,000 with a 4% APY?' aur 'What is 5% APY on $1000 monthly?' poochhe ja rahe hain, aur top result bank calculators hain jo APY/APR ko mix karte hain. Business-days par observed PAA ('How long is 5 business days from today?', 'What is 3 business days in days?') ne maujooda table ko confirm kiya, is liye wahan naya section nahi likha gaya — sirf maujooda table mein +10 business days ka column joda gaya (do hafte ka pattern) aur 3–5 din ka calendar span likha gaya, taake duplicate second table na bane.
changes.measured: Neeche §4 dekho (baseline: data/page-exposure-baseline-batch2.json). Har naya number apne calculator ke formula se recompute kiya gaya aur tests/unit/enhance-claims.test.js usay lock karta hai.
changes.tradeoff: APY card lamba ho gaya (value table + naming paragraph), is liye uske neeche ke desc sections thoda neeche gaye — §4 mein delta dekho. Business-days ke table mein ek column add hua (row ke andar, is liye table ka offset nahi badla); uske neeche ka FAQ thoda neeche gaya, aur comparison/modifier buckets pehle se hi threshold ke bahar the.
